'''Rune''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Fall Of The Republic|final decades]] before the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

By [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], Rune had a sizable [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] placed on his head by the Empire, becoming one of the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]] top ten most wanted fugitives and was killed by a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]].

==Biography==
[[File:MonCal_Form_V_SWGTCG.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Rune utilizing the Shien variant of Form V.]]
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]], Rune was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Having constructed a [[blue]]-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], Rune escaped execution when the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] betrayed the Jedi through the initiation of [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|Contingency]] [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]]. As the Order was disbanded and the few survivors scattered, Rune was placed on a list of other Jedi survivors by the newly formed [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. By [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], he had a sizable [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] placed on his head, becoming one of the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]] top ten most wanted fugitives. At this time, an unknown [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] tracked down the Jedi and killed him, collecting the long-standing bounty.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rune, along with several other fugitives of various backgrounds, ranging from murderers to [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] deserters, is part of a kill collection in the MMORPG [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']]. Bounty Hunter players using the skill "Bounty Check" may check random humanoid NPCs throughout the galaxy, randomly exposing one of the ten fugitives. Killing the fugitive will add them to the player's collection. Killing all ten rewards the player with two schematics, the first for a improved version of the [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A blaster rifle]], the second for a similarly improved version of the [[EE-3 carbine rifle/Legends|EE-3 carbine rifle]]. The collection was repeatable, allowing the player to repeat it for more schematics.
